title: UPS on battery: ATS failed to transfer to a healthy generator
description: Utility power is out (a known upstream event) and generator GEN-1 is running at rated voltage, but ATS-1 never transferred to it, so both UPS units are discharging.

alarms.message: UPS-A1 on battery, 13 minutes runtime remaining (alarm below 15)
UPS-B1 on battery, 13 minutes runtime remaining (alarm below 15)
ATS-1 failed to transfer to emergency source: source 2 (GEN-1) available at 480 V, transfer timer expired after 15 s, switch still on source 1 (utility, 0 V)
UTIL-1 feeder outage, known and acknowledged: feeder fault reported by the utility, restoration pending

notes.AL-2003: Generator GEN-1 is running at rated voltage and available as source 2.
